scope: Compiler-owned raw machine primitives. Separate from B Lisp entry; every argument is a Wasm i32 parameter and the single result is i32. These words never enter the B root stack. Full Lisp calls remain LL05.

representations.address: Unsigned byte address; high bit is meaningful
representations.node: D1 tagged word, validated by each conversion
representations.code-id: Nonnegative target fixnum proven issued in the supplied registry
representations.slot: Raw table index proven against kind, capacity, reserved prefix, signature, role and presence

code_registry.invariant: 0 <= first <= next <= limit <= 2^29; issued IDs are [first,next)
code_registry.ownership: Single owner; stable during a primitive; no reuse or concurrent access. Initialization belongs to the caller; invalid contents are refused.

slot_registry.ownership: Caller owns metadata and actual table installation, stable during validation and use. This is not the production module-loader registry.
slot_registry.reserved_prefix_source: Owner-supplied; no C linker or element-segment reservation claim.

array_bytes: Count must be below 2^24, width positive, product <= 2^32-1. Computes payload bytes only, not object allocation or a header.
